scope: Editorial redesign of homepage, commercial/residential pages, project collection and shared public surfaces; authentic photography, light/dark themes and SEO preservation

checks: Mobile navigation traps keyboard focus, Escape closes and restores trigger focus
Theme toggle works and persists after reload
No horizontal overflow in checked public layouts
Server-rendered photograph, headings and links work without JavaScript
List/Grid views and commercial/residential filters preserve 10/5/5 project counts
Project title and View project text links remain available
Production gallery advances and closes with Escape
Shared dark CTA eyebrow corrected and verified as rgb(188,199,199) on rgb(21,34,38)

photoContrast.method: Sampled rendered background pixels behind hero text to resolve axe image/gradient manual checks
photoContrast.limitation: These checks cover the current image and tested crops. Recheck contrast when changing hero photography.

lighthouse.environment: Local production build; Lighthouse mobile simulation, not field Core Web Vitals
lighthouse.seoNote: The only failed weighted SEO audit is indexability: SITE_INDEXABLE remains false for the prelaunch preview. All other weighted SEO audits pass.
lighthouse.performanceNote: The real hero image is eagerly loaded with high fetch priority and a responsive source sized for its cover crop. Slow-mobile lab LCP remains above the 2.5-second target; render-blocking CSS is the largest reported remaining opportunity.

design.hero: Authentic completed Upper West Side living room, large white headline, transparent white logo
design.divisionSeparation: Dedicated routes and navigation, prominent homepage entry links and contrasting full-width sections
design.projectPresentation: Large unframed photography, alternating List and staggered Grid layouts, visible case-study links
design.motion: Brief hover/focus transitions only, with reduced-motion support; no autoplay, canvas, decorative model, drawing animation or comparison sliders
design.ownerControls: Existing publishing, featured selection, ordering, uploads and inquiry handling preserved
